brief: Plays a score live, posting each note to an engine timeline just before its frame.
detail: The notes are rendered first, all of them, so no instrument tunes itself while the performance runs. Notes are then posted a ring plus half a second ahead of the producer, and the engine counts any that still arrive after their frame in Late. Play and RunToEnd use a sound card through a transport and were not run in this reference. RenderThroughRing runs the same real-time path with this thread draining the ring instead of a card, so it opens no device, and its output matched the offline render of the same score at every 97th sample. The sound has not been heard by a person (UNPERCEIVED): it is checked by frame count, sample rate and peak level, not by listening.
